title: Expanded cochain component core for ordinary pullback evaluation transition
statement: For the same data as the degreewise ordinary pullback evaluation transition square, after expanding the ordinary pullback evaluation complex into the inverse evaluation isomorphism followed by the mapped intrinsic pullback isomorphism, the displayed component equality holds at a cochain degree i. This is the explicit component calculation used by the parent statement.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and paragraph preceding Lemma 4.10, degreewise section calculation.

proof.text: The proved private ordinary_evaluation_mate lemma identifies the inverse ordinary evaluation comparison with the mate of direct evaluation. It uses the inverse-evaluation Hom characterization and preservation of the adjunction unit by pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic.

Apply the proved integralPullEvaluation_directTransitionSquare, which computes the adjacent coefficient transition square on direct-image sections using the canonical scalar comparison and its heterogeneous normalization.

Apply the private evaluation_transition_mate lemma to transpose that square. Its proof cancels the evaluation isomorphisms, applies the higher-level adjunction Hom equivalence, and uses unit_mateEquiv, unit_mateEquiv_symm and naturality. Thus the direct-image equation implies the ordinary inverse-image equation.

Evaluate the ordinary square at P.X i and expand the mapHomologicalComplex and composite natural-isomorphism components. The complex composition comparison contributes only identity maps; functoriality and associativity give the target equality.

proof_origin.place: Construction 4.1 and the paragraph before Lemma 4.10; implemented by direct-image section calculation, adjunction-unit mate transposition and component expansion, G9, 2026-10-28.

theorem integralPullEvaluation_cochainSquare_component_core_expanded
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (r₀ : normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n) ⋙
        proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 2)) ≅
      proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) ⋙
        normalizedDVRModuleRes l E Y (Nat.le_succ n))
    (hr₀ : HEq r₀ (proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison f
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionTransition l E (n + 1))).symm)
    (P : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ) (i : ℤ) :
    ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
        (coefficientSequenceTransition l E X (Nat.le_succ n)) (.up ℤ)).app
        (((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)).f i ≫
      (((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (((pullbackTensorInverseEvaluationComplex l E f n).symm ≪≫
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic l E f n)
        (.up ℤ))).hom.app P)).f i =
    ((((pullbackTensorInverseEvaluationComplex l E f (n + 1)).symm ≪≫
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y (n + 1)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic l E f (n + 1))
        (.up ℤ))).hom.app P)).f i ≫
      (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 2)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
          (coefficientSequenceTransition l E Y (Nat.le_succ n)) (.up ℤ)).app P)).f i ≫
      ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
        ((mateEquiv
            (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)))
            (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 2)))).symm
          (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ r₀.inv)).natTrans (.up ℤ)).app
        (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)).f i
